claim_text: Alkane has already commenced actively restoring native Fuzzy Box Woodland in broad drainage lines that would have originally carried this species.
metric_name: Fuzzy Box seedlings planted; fenced land area
context_text:
Lands totalling 123.3ha have been fenced and in August 2024 were planted with 1,200 Fuzzy Box seedlings propagated from seed collected from remnant Fuzzy Box stands on Alkane’s land at Tomingley.
The Fuzzy Box seedlings planted in August 2024 continue to do well. By March 2025, they had almost doubled in size.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report provides direct evidence of active restoration through fencing, planting, and early growth outcomes.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that Alkane has already commenced active restoration of native Fuzzy Box Woodland in broad drainage lines that would have originally carried the species. The evidence states that 123.3 ha of land has been fenced and, in August 2024, planted with 1,200 Fuzzy Box seedlings propagated from locally collected seed on Alkane’s land, and that by March 2025 the seedlings had almost doubled in size. This substantiates that restoration activities have commenced and are active, with specific actions, timing, and quantities. While the evidence does not explicitly repeat the phrase “broad drainage lines,” it does describe restoration of Fuzzy Box using local provenance seedlings on Alkane’s land, which materially supports the commencement of restoring Fuzzy Box Woodland as claimed.
